SEMI-DETACHED 3-BED IN PRIME BLACKROCK LOCATION
Churches Estate Agents are delighted to present this rare opportunity, a blank canvas of a house, with huge potential to modernise and extend. Castlebyrne Park was built in the 1950s as a Dublin Corporation House. These are solidly-built terraced homes, usually with generous gardens. No. 17 is no exception and benefits from being end-of-terrace or semi-detached, featuring a useful side passage to the spacious rear garden. There is also plentiful off-street parking in the front garden area.  

This property presents a fantastic opportunity to extend to the front, side or rear, and even potentially upwards into the attic (Subject To Planning) like many other neighbouring properties have spectacularly. Given the unique location in the heart of Blackrock, a buyer could turn this into a fabulous family home for the long term.

Castlebyrne Park is located just off Newtownpark Avenue, a short distance from the centre of Blackrock, with its shops, amenities, DART station and the coast. There are a plethora of excellent schools on your doorstep, from Guardian Angels and Carysfort National at Primary Level, to Newtown Secondary or Blackrock College and Sion Hill at Secondary.  Finally, the hidden gem as Castlebyrne is direct access to the little known Rockbrook Park, a wonderful hidden green space that connects the estate to Blackrock Village and includes unique woods, playgrounds, pitches and even a tennis club.

No 16 Castlebyrne Park has retained most of the original layout of the house. The front rooms were at some time opened up to create one large living room facing the road. Behind, a small kitchen has a small galley extension, and an understairs storage pantry. There is the opportunity to extend this part of the house into the large rear garden.

Upstairs, there is a abthroom and separate WC on the split level of the stairs, and finally two doubles and one single bedroom on the first floor. A spacious attic could also have conversion potential with the right plans.

Overall, this house requires a keen eye and a clever design to turn it into a modern home. But the opportunities are endless. A Must See.
